prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit ONLY the BACKGROUND of the most recent user-attached image, the selected police-station armwrestling concept. Return one complete image with the SAME canvas size, camera, framing, illustration style, palette, and lighting as the attached image.

STRICT FOREGROUND INVARIANTS: preserve the main adult woman exactly: her recognizable face, expression, eyes, hair, pearl earring, police uniform, body and both arms. Preserve the intertwined armwrestling hands and foreground player forearm with the red-and-white wristband exactly. Preserve the full competition table, red elbow pads and black side pegs exactly. Preserve the cream-colored dog wearing black glasses with yellow/amber lenses at the right exactly. Preserve the existing parrot on the left reception counter and the tabby cat on the far-right filing cabinet.

REQUESTED BACKGROUND EDITS:
1. Remove BOTH background HUMAN police officers completely: the dark-haired male at the left reception counter and the blonde female at the back-right desk. No background people, no human substitutes or silhouettes. Reconstruct their former areas naturally with the existing police-station furnishings.
2. Add THREE additional small friendly animals, all behind the foreground heroine and table:
- a ginger/orange cat sitting on the left reception counter in the former male officer area, leaving the existing parrot clearly visible;
- a small white rabbit on the back-right desk in the former female officer area, among the files but with a clearly readable silhouette;
- a small brown-and-white puppy sitting on the floor near the far-left side of the reception counter, behind the competition table.
They are ordinary animals with natural anatomy, not humanoids, do not wear human police uniforms. Match the illustrated style and coherent perspective, with clean dark brown outlines and warm shading. They must not overlap the heroine's face, hair silhouette, central wrestling clasp, hands or arms, and must not obscure her cream dog in yellow glasses. Keep the station recognizable: counter, files, cabinets, desk lamps, windows and bulletin boards. Compose the animals into the background without clutter. Do not change or beautify any foreground element. Do not add text, UI, captions, borders or watermarks. Opaque background.
